jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description: We're looking for a sharp, hands-on Controller to join our Finance team. If you like owning the numbers end-to-end, not just closing the books but understanding why they look the way they do - this is the place for you. You'll report to the Director of Finance and be a key player in managing the financials of a global tech company run out of Israel. This is a role for someone who moves fast and isn't precious about rolling up sleeves, excels in direct communication, and has a "let's solve it now" mentality. What you'll own Monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting (US GAAP), including close process management and reporting to the Director of Finance. Statutory tax filings and full compliance with Israeli tax authorities and regulatory requirements. Managing external auditors, tax advisors, and statutory filing deadlines. Logistics and financial coordination - working cross-functionally with operations/logistics to ensure financial processes align with the physical/operational side of the business. Managing and mentoring the Accounts Payable team - reviewing processes, approvals, and vendor payment cycles. Strengthening internal controls, close procedures, AI tools and practices and financial processes as the company scales. What we're looking for Big 4 alumni (Big 4 audit/assurance background strongly preferred) - you know how to build and defend a clean set of books. Prior experience as a Controller or Assistant Controller at a tech company - you understand SaaS/tech revenue models and the pace of a tech organization. Deep familiarity with Israeli tax and regulatory reporting requirements CPA Strong Excel skills; comfort working with ERP/accounting systems (NetSuite, SAP or similar). Fluent Hebrew and English A "get it done" attitude - you don't wait for permission to fix a broken process About MyHeritage MyHeritage is the leading global discovery platform for exploring family history. With billions of historical records and family tree profiles, and with sophisticated matching technologies that work across all its assets, MyHeritage gives users the joy of discovering their past and empowering their future. MyHeritage is the most popular DNA test and family history service in Europe. Since 2020, MyHeritage is also home to the world’s most advanced AI technologies for repairing, enhancing, colorizing, and animating historical photos. Learn more at www.myheritage.com . See what it’s like to work at MyHeritage on www.glassdoor.com . jobs.description: Are you a great communicator with a passion for helping people? Join a team where you can make a real impact by keeping customers connected to a product they love. At MyHeritage, we’re looking for driven and empathetic individuals to join our Retention team and help our global customers continue their journey of family discovery. As a Retention Representative, your primary role is to engage with paying customers who have requested a refund for their annual subscriptions, understand their concerns, and offer tailored solutions to retain them as valued members. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at MyHeritage, you will play a crucial role in developing and implementing machine learning models that drive our products and user experiences. You will have a significant impact on our large and growing user base by leveraging the latest AI technologies to solve challenging problems at scale. This is a unique opportunity to join a forward-thinking team that is passionate about innovation, data, and machine learning. What you’ll do Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models for various business needs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, product managers, and software engineers, to integrate ML solutions into production systems. Experiment with and iterate on model architectures to improve accuracy, efficiency, and scalability. Work with large datasets to preprocess, clean, and extract meaningful features for model training. Utilize MLOps best practices to automate and streamline the development lifecycle of ML models. Monitor model performance and fine-tune for optimization. Stay updated with the latest research and advancements in machine learning and AI. What you bring Technical skills: Strong foundation in machine learning techniques such as supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, and vision/NLP experience. Proficiency in Python, along with popular ML libraries and frameworks such as PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, pandas, NumPy, SciPy, TensorFlow. Experience with data preprocessing and feature engineering for structured and unstructured data. Knowledge of model deployment and serving, using tools like Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-based services (AWS, GCP, Azure). Familiarity with MLOps tools for automation and monitoring (e.g., MLFlow, ClearML). Experience with SQL for data extraction and analysis (optional). Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in software development, including at least 3 years of experience in the machine learning domains. Experience working in a B2C company or a similar high-paced environment is an advantage. Proven track record of implementing impactful machine learning solutions in production. Core attributes Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to tackle complex problems with creativity and efficiency. Excellent communication skills for conveying technical ideas to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. High level of attention to detail and quality in your work. Ability to work effectively in a team environment, while also being a self-starter when working independently. Curious and eager to keep learning about the latest trends in AI and machine learning. Comfortable in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment with changing priorities. About MyHeritage MyHeritage is the leading global discovery platform for exploring family history. With billions of historical records and family tree profiles, and with sophisticated matching technologies that work across all its assets, MyHeritage gives users the joy of discovering their past and empowering their future. MyHeritage is the most popular DNA test and family history service in Europe. Since 2020, MyHeritage is also home to the world’s most advanced AI technologies for repairing, enhancing, colorizing, and animating historical photos. Learn more at www.myheritage.com . jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Security Engineer to join our security team and lead initiatives across our corporate systems, cloud infrastructure, and AI-enabled environments. You will play a critical role in designing practical security controls, driving complex security projects, and fostering a culture of secure innovation as we scale. What you’ll do Own security initiatives across corporate systems, endpoints, identities, SaaS, cloud, and internal infrastructure. Design and implement practical security controls that reduce risk without slowing the business. Own the security review and approval process for AI tools, AI-enabled applications, and autonomous agents across the organization. Define security requirements and guardrails that enable teams to adopt AI securely. Evaluate new technologies, integrations, and architectures and provide clear security recommendations. Lead security projects from assessment and design through implementation and ongoing operation. Work closely with IT, Infrastructure, DevOps, R&D, Legal, and business teams. Investigate security issues and drive remediation. What you bring Strong security mindset with a practical, hands-on approach. Ability to take an ambiguous security problem, assess the risk, define a solution, and drive implementation. Good understanding of modern enterprise, SaaS, cloud, and AI-enabled environments. Ability to balance security requirements with business and engineering needs. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Technical skills Identity and access management, SSO, MFA, privileged access, and least privilege. Endpoint security, EDR, device hardening, and endpoint privilege management. SaaS and cloud security, preferably AWS. Network security and Zero Trust principles. Security monitoring, logging, and incident investigation. Security automation using scripting, APIs, or automation platforms. Understanding of AI security risks, including data exposure, permissions, integrations, and autonomous agents. Familiarity with application security and CI/CD security is an advantage. Experience 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, infrastructure security, cloud security, or a related security role. Proven experience implementing and operating security controls in production environments. Proven experience independently leading complex security initiatives across multiple technical teams. Experience working with IT, Infrastructure, DevOps, or engineering teams. Experience with SaaS, AI security, or emerging technology assessments is an advantage. Core attributes Ownership and independence. Strong problem-solving skills. Practical security judgment. Hands-on mentality. Secure enablement mindset. Strong collaboration and communication.
